doc.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Conjunto Bolero for the US with Carmen and Rolando
summary: He stayed with Tata Gutierrez's Conjunto Bolero until 1946, then came to the United States with the dancing couple Carmen and Rolando.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: The last group with which you had participated you tell us was the Septeto Apolo.
Then after that, to which group did you go?
To the Conjunto del Bolero of 1935.
How long were you with them? Tell us, where did they play?
Well, I was with them until the year ‘46.
From there I came to the United States in 1946 with a pair of dancers, Carmen and Rolando. They were the ones that brought me.
But I understand that before you traveled to the United States with them, you were traveling throughout Cuba with them, right?
